instruction: A cinematic still, medium shot in an outdoor park near a waterfront. On the left, the man in the beige corduroy shirt (R1) stands facing right, looking at his partner with a warm, friendly smile. On the right, the woman in the beige hijab and black polka-dot dress (R2) stands with her back partially turned to the camera. They are holding hands, facing each other in an intimate moment. The background shows a soft-focus view of green trees and distant buildings under bright, natural daylight, creating a warm and peaceful mood.
